## R Markdown

```{r}
#Indsat ved vejledning fra chatgpt til at kunne forbinde de indsatte filer til at kunne anvende funktionen "analyze()"
library(pdftools)

analyze <- function(file_path) {
  text <- pdf_text(file_path)
  if (length(text) >= 2) {
    cat(text[2])
  } else {
    cat("PDF has fewer than 2 pages.\n") #ønsker kun 2. side i hver dokument
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Følger guiden fra software carpentry 
list.files(path = "breve_gøye", pattern = "pdf")
```

```{r}
#Følger guiden fra software carpentry 
list.files(path = "breve_gøye", pattern = "breve_Gøye,Birgitte", full.names = TRUE)
```
```{r}
#Følger guiden fra software carpentry 
filenames <- list.files(path = "breve_gøye",  
                        pattern = "breve_Gøye,Birgitte-[0-10]{2}.pdf",
                        full.names = TRUE)
for (f in filenames) {
  print(f)
  analyze(f)
}
```

```{r}
#Kombinere det med tidytext
analyze <- function(file_path) {
  text <- pdf_text(file_path)
  
  if (length(text) < 2) {
    return(tibble(file = basename(file_path), word = NA))
  }

  second_page <- text[2]
  #ønsker kun 2. side på hver dokument
  
  tibble(file = basename(file_path), text = second_page) %>%
    unnest_tokens(word, text)
}
```

```{r}
filenames <- list.files(path = "breve_gøye",  
                        pattern = "breve_Gøye,Birgitte-[0-10]{2}.pdf",
                        full.names = TRUE)

# Use lapply to process all files and bind results
all_wordsgøye <- lapply(filenames, analyze) %>%
  bind_rows()
all_wordsgøye
```


```{r}
# Alle ord uden tal dvs. ikke anvendt stoplist
all_wordsgøye_no_numeric <- all_wordsgøye%>% 
  filter(is.na(as.numeric(word)))
all_wordsgøye_no_numeric
```

```{r}
#download data til at cluster med OpenRefine 
write.csv(all_wordsgøye_no_numeric, "all_wordsgøye_no_numeric.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
gøyeclustered<-read.csv2("Clustered/all-wordsgøye-clustered.csv", na="NULL")
gøyeclustered
```

```{r}
#Fjerner stopord 
my_stops <- readLines("stoplist.txt")
my_stops_df <- tibble(word = my_stops)

all_words_clustered <- gøyeclustered%>%
  filter(!is.na(word)) %>%
  anti_join(my_stops_df, by = "word")
all_words_clustered
```
```{r}
# Calculate the most frequent words
most_used_words <- all_words_clustered %>%
  count(word, sort = TRUE)  # 'sort = TRUE' arranges words by frequency in descending order

# View the top 10 most frequent words
head(most_used_words, 250)
```
